consigna: Friday, spoken: talk for 90 seconds about a day out or a trip — what happened and what you thought about it. Note two or three ideas first, then speak.
requisitos: A story with *first* and *then* in the past (week 40)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Look through all your corrections from weeks 38 to 45. Which mistake stayed all year? Write it down.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences about that mistake — this time correct.
*Fri (5 min).* Record 90 seconds. Then listen: is the mistake gone?
autochequeo: Did the story have a clear order?
Did I give a reason for my opinion?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three things at A2 level: telling a simple story, modals of obligation and ability, and opinion with a reason. (1) For each one, say if it is there and if it is correct. (2) Tell me the mistake that is still there. (3) Give me one sentence with all three. Correct nothing else. ---
